model: claude-opus-5-5 (same model family as the drafting passes)
sampleMethod: Random: node research/china-labs-3/tools.mjs sample 20 20261029 (mulberry32, 20% of 212 records). Targeted: every capital, inferred, reporting-only, legal-entity, founding and co-founding record, every developer entry in a CAC listing, and the licence records with territory exclusions, a dated licence change or an internal conflict, not already drawn at random.
method: The auditor read AGENTS.md, docs/editorial-policy.md (Atomic claims and sources, Short quotation, Interpretation, Machine-first workflow), scope.md and drafting-brief.md, then the 78 sampled records with their evidence, sources and entities from pack.json. The drafting passes' 'searched' notes were not read. Every source cited by a sampled record (56 sources) was retrieved again, sequentially and directly, into the auditor's own cache (LG_CACHE=audit, keys audit-<source id>); each quote or paraphrase anchor was located with the tool's normalisation and read in context with tools.mjs text/grep and pdftotext -layout (for table rows, page numbers and wrapped filing numbers). Versions and dates were checked against Hugging Face commit and tree APIs (Yi-34B, Yi-1.5-34B, step3, Step-5-Preview, Hunyuan-A13B-Instruct, HunyuanVideo, Tencent-Hunyuan-Large, SenseNova-U1-8B-MoT, Aquila-7B, Intern-S1, Hy3), by fetching earlier README and LICENSE revisions where a record makes a dated licence or history claim (Yi-34B README scan for the Llama sentence; Yi-34B LICENSE before 30 May 2024; HunyuanVideo LICENSE of 2 and 4 December 2024; Tencent-Hunyuan-Large LICENSE.txt from 5 November 2024; Step-5-Preview README of 13 October 2026), and by a blobless clone of InternLM/InternLM in the scratchpad. CAC list counts were recounted from the layout text, and 'earliest list' statements for DeepSeek and BAAI were checked against attachments 1-7 of the CAC page (attachments 3, 5 and 6 fetched for this purpose). Chinese passages were read in Chinese and the machine translations compared. Same-family check: it does not satisfy the editorial policy's cross-family requirement.
